Dune Suite

Ocean-facing, private terrace

The rooms everyone means when they say they stayed at Aurelia. A single long window frames nothing but water, and the terrace sits close enough to the bluff edge that the sound of the surf never really stops.

Size
620 sq ft
Beds
One king
View
Open ocean
Sleeps
2 (max 3)

Built into the original 1974 wing and stripped back to its Douglas fir frame in the 2019 restoration. The bed faces the window rather than the door — a deliberate inversion that costs a little wall space and buys the entire view from where you actually spend the night.

  • Ocean view
  • Terrace
  • Soaking tub
  • Fireplace
  • Rain shower

$534 per night, from

What is actually in it.

  • Private terrace with two lounge chairs and a gas fire bowl
  • Douglas fir ceiling and exposed original framing
  • Soaking tub positioned to the ocean window
  • Marshall speaker, no television
  • Filtered coffee, local tea, and a decanter of house amaro

What it costs, by season.

Plus a $42 nightly facilities fee and 11.75% county tax, both shown in every quote before you enter any details. Additional guests beyond 2 are $75 per night. Breakfast, sauna and parking are included.
